mode: one-shot minimal hypothesis test (NOT a method-development experiment)
question: does explicitly modeling a SHARED object-level latent state that jointly constrains all K keypoint direction fields (cross-keypoint structural coupling) recover OCC direction error where EXP009/010/011 post-hoc aggregations and EXP012's kp-independent decoder could not, under the EXP012 in-sample fitting protocol?
hypothesis: PVNet regresses the K keypoint direction fields approximately independently per pixel; the K fields share one object-level geometric state; making that state explicit and shared across the K readouts reduces correlated direction errors under occlusion.

motivation_from_repo.EXP005: OCC degradation is NOT vote-count: equal-count LIN still 1.8x better (1.61 vs 2.90 px); degradation monotone toward occlusion boundary
motivation_from_repo.EXP006: the degraded axis is DIRECTION (LIN 2.969 deg vs OCC 5.121 deg, unit space); magnitude excluded; degradation concentrated in kp2/kp3/kp7
motivation_from_repo.EXP008: oracle context recovers the error (global oracle 0.001 deg; local r=3 0.569 deg) -> information present, representation-limited
motivation_from_repo.EXP009: frozen kp-independent local residual: LIN +5.5% but OCC -25.7% (STOP)
motivation_from_repo.EXP010: validity-aware local selection 3.2x WORSE than blind local aggregation (STOP)
motivation_from_repo.EXP012: kp-independent 3x3->1x1 decoder on frozen F: OCC +21.1% in-sample (GO-A) => capacity matters, but the readout is still 9 independent fields with NO shared object state
motivation_from_repo.EXP013: the D1 improvement generalizes to held-out images (+19.83%)

objects: cat only (first round tests mechanism existence, not object generality)

data.images: the EXP005-012 fixed deterministic pool: 20 LINEMOD cat val + 20 OCC cat test
data.training_set == evaluation_set: yes, by protocol (in-sample capacity/mechanism probe, EXP012 convention); generalization is NOT this experiment's question (that was EXP013's)

conditions.A: original PVNet vertex head convraw[3] (frozen 199.pth), NO training (task spec section 8: 'do not retrain the baseline')
conditions.B: OCVF: v'_k(p) = normalize(v0_k(p) + dV_k(p)) where v0 = original frozen vertex output, dV from the object-consistency module; ONLY the module is trained
conditions.shared: identical checkpoint, identical images, identical seed, identical evaluation code path, identical voting, identical pool definitions; segmentation path and trunk untouched and frozen

architecture.frozen: ResNet18_8s trunk + conv8s/4s/2s + convraw incl. original 1x1 vertex head + segmentation head (eval mode, no grad, BN stats untouched)

module.object_latent: Z = mean of F over PREDICTED foreground (argmax seg == 1); z = Linear(32->64)(Z)
module.queries: 9 learnable query embeddings q_k in R^64, init N(0, 0.02^2)
module.context: c_k = Linear(64->64)->LeakyReLU(0.1)->Linear(64->64)([q_k; z]) — SHARED weights across k
module.residual: dV_k(p) = Conv1x1(64->2)( LeakyReLU(0.1)( Conv1x1(96->64)( [F(p); c_k] ) ) ) — SHARED conv weights across all 9 keypoints (NOT 9 independent heads); final conv ZERO-initialized (EXP007-trap control: at init B == A exactly)
module.config_head: chat = Linear(64->18)(z) reshaped (9,2) px; weight ZERO-init, bias init = image center (W/2, H/2) per keypoint
module.forbidden: no Transformer, no attention, no graph network, no BN, no multi-scale, no cross-attention; input to module is ONLY (F, predicted seg) — no GT keypoints, no GT pose, no GT visibility mask, no GT directions

losses.L_dir: lib.utils.net_utils.smooth_l1_loss(normalize(v0 + dV), dataset GT vertex targets, fg vertex weights, normalize=True) — the ORIGINAL PVNet direction supervision, EXP012 verbatim formula; GT used only as training TARGET (allowed); model input never sees GT
losses.L_conf: (1/D) * mean_k ||chat_k - gt_kp_k||_2, D = sqrt(H^2 + W^2); trains the configuration head so chat is a meaningful object-level keypoint-configuration hypothesis; GT keypoints are the TARGET, never the input
losses.L_struct: mean over (fg pixels p, k) with |gt_kp_k - p| >= 1px AND |chat_k - p| >= 1px of [1 - cos(v'_k(p), normalize(chat_k - p))]; WHY this is cross-keypoint coupling: all 9 fields are pulled toward ONE configuration hypothesis chat predicted from the SINGLE shared object latent z — the fields cannot satisfy it independently; degenerate solution 'ignore chat' is possible in principle and is exactly what criterion C3 tests
losses.total: L = L_dir + 1.0 * L_conf + 1.0 * L_struct (weights fixed BEFORE the run; no tuning allowed)
losses.leakage_check: no GT tensor is an input anywhere; runtime verification in-run (see gates)

training.protocol: EXP012 in-sample convention: OCVF-LIN fitted on the 20 LIN images and evaluated on the same 20; OCVF-OCC fitted on the 20 OCC images and evaluated on the same 20
training.budget: 5 epochs (HARD CAP), image-level batch=1 (module needs whole-image pooling), Adam lr=1e-3 on module params only, seed 0 re-seeded per fit
training.stopping: final state used; no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, no loss-based selection
training.debug_policy: one implementation-bug fix allowed (loss NaN / divergence / collapse); after fix, rerun from scratch ONCE; no lr sweep, no loss-weight sweep, no architecture change; if it still fails -> STOP

metrics.M1_M5_direction: EXP006/012 pool (visible fg pixels with |K-p|>=1px, 9 kps pooled), angle between unit pred and unit GT (deg): mean/median/p90 per split; identical code to EXP012 evaluate()

M6_consistency.definition: GT-free ray-coherence metric. For image i, keypoint k: rays u_j = unit field at eligible fg pixels p_j (pool: fg & |gt_kp_k - p_j| >= 1px; GT used ONLY for pool selection, matching the EXP006 pool convention). Configuration hypothesis = per-kp least-squares ray-intersection point c_k: solve [n*I - sum(u u^T)] c = sum(p - u (u.p)) (+1e-6*n ridge). Per-ray residual d_j = |det(u_j, c_k - p_j)| (perpendicular distance, px). Per (i,k): median d_j. Per image: median over the 9 kps. Per split: mean/median/p90 over 20 images. Degenerate (n < 50 or normal-matrix cond > 1e12) excluded and counted.
M6_consistency.interpretation: lower = the 9 direction fields are better explained by a single coherent keypoint configuration; EXP005 already used the LS ray-intersection estimator as its counterfactual estimator

metrics.M7_keypoints: original ransac_voting_layer_v3 (CUDA) on the A field (raw v0, original pipeline) and the B field (normalize(v0+dV)); mask = argmax seg (identical for A and B); seed re-applied before EVERY voting call (EXP014/015 verbatim); ROUND_HYP=128, INLIER_THRESH=0.99, MAX_NUM=100; keypoint error = ||kp_pred - gt_kp|| px; per-split pooled median over 20x9=180 errors (EXP015 convention)
metrics.field_roughness: EXP012 smoothing check (neighbor variation of unit field), reported, NOT a criterion
metrics.occ_proximity_bands: 0-5 / 5-20 / 20+ px (EXP005/012 definitions), reported, NOT a criterion

gates_abort_if_failed.G1: A direction metrics reproduce EXP006: |LIN-2.969|<0.05, |OCC-5.121|<0.05, pooled counts exactly 440940/250033
gates_abort_if_failed.G2: A full-image L_dir at init matches EXP012 references: LIN 0.002869, OCC 0.008945 (tol 1e-4)
gates_abort_if_failed.G3: init identity: B(at init) == A: max|v'_init - v0_hat| == 0 and voting keypoints |diff| < 1e-3 px (voting is scale-invariant by construction; verified in-run)
gates_abort_if_failed.G4: no-GT-input verification: module forward signature is exactly (feat, seg); repeated forward with deliberately corrupted GT tensors (vertex_gt, gt_kps, pose, mask_gt) produces BIT-IDENTICAL v'; passed before any training
gates_abort_if_failed.G5: A voting keypoint pooled median reproduces EXP015: LIN 1.111 +/- 0.05 px, OCC 3.150 +/- 0.05 px

decision_criteria.C3: structural consistency clearly better: (A_occ - B_occ)/A_occ >= 0.05 on M6 OCC median AND (B_lin - A_lin)/A_lin <= 0.05 on M6 LIN median
decision_criteria.C4: OCC voted keypoint pooled median no clear degradation: B <= 1.05 * A (M7)
decision_criteria.rule: GO iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4; otherwise STOP (no exception, no 'partially satisfied continues'). If 1-3 criteria hold but not all: decision is STOP, profile reported as MIXED (partial satisfaction), framed strictly as a failed hypothesis test. No second seed, no more epochs, no data increase, no loss/architecture change, no EXP022.

exp012_distinctness_requirement: the ONLY mechanistic difference from EXP012's D1 must be the shared object latent z and the shared-across-keypoint residual readout (cross-keypoint coupling). If the trained module effectively behaves as 9 independent context heads (i.e. C3 fails and the coupling pathway is unused), the implementation does NOT qualify as a valid OCVF test and this must be stated in the REPORT.
voting_input_B: RAW refined field (v0 + dV) is fed to voting — voting kernels are scale-invariant w.r.t. the direction field (in-run check: raw vs unit field voting differs 3.63e-02 px = float-noise amplified by RANSAC discrete selection); direction metrics and all losses use normalize(v0 + dV) (task-spec form); zero-init control then makes B's voting BIT-IDENTICAL to A's at init
run_history: run 1 aborted at gate G3 (voting identity): the gate compared voting on raw v0 vs unit-normalized v0 with a 1e-3 px tolerance, but float32 rounding through the RANSAC discrete selection gives 3.63e-02 px — a gate-design flaw, hit BEFORE any training or fitting; fix = feed B's RAW field to voting (bit-identical at init); run 2 restarted from scratch; no loss/architecture/epoch change

deviations.D1: A is evaluated frozen (no fitting) per task spec section 8; 'identical training budget' is implemented as: B uses exactly the EXP012 5-epoch fitting budget, A uses none — this is the task's own definition of the A condition
deviations.D2: training is image-level (batch=1, 20 steps/epoch) instead of EXP012's pixel-minibatch (4096): the OCVF module requires whole-image masked pooling for z; epoch budget identical (5)
deviations.D3: two module instances (OCVF-LIN, OCVF-OCC), one per split, fitted independently — EXP012's D1-LIN/D1-OCC convention, keeps per-split domain budget identical to EXP012

forbidden_aftermath: if not GO: no 10-epoch rerun, no second seed, no loss swap, no architecture swap, no attention/graph, no third object, no data increase, no EXP022
